<<On Airing Out A Boathouse This Season>>

This season, we are inviting the community to participate in a special event to air out the boathouse. The boathouse, located on the lake, has been closed for the winter, and we believe it's time to bring it back to life. The gable of the boathouse will be opened for the first time in many years, allowing the community to enjoy the fresh air and the view from the top. 

To ensure the boathouse is properly ventilated, we will be using the flue to remove any moisture and prevent mold growth. The flue will be checked and cleaned before the season begins, ensuring a safe and comfortable environment for all. Additionally, the gravel around the boathouse will be cleared to allow for better airflow and a more pleasant experience for visitors. 

We encourage everyone to join us in this effort to keep the boathouse fresh and enjoyable this season. Together, we can make sure the boathouse is ready for the coming season.
